question: A bookseller sold a book for Rs. 40 at a 15% profit on cost. At what price should it be sold to earn a 20% profit on the same cost?

explanationUrdu: درست جواب Rs. 41.74 ہے۔ اصل لاگت 40 / 1.15 اور نئی قیمت اس لاگت کا 120% ہے، جو تقریباً 41.74 بنتی ہے۔

sourceNotes: The duplicated wording '15% percent' was corrected and 'profit on cost' was made explicit; rounding to two decimal places gives option A.
